summary: ObjectGenome schema v1 does not fully determine hinge/tilt geometry: a hinge or tilt mechanism stores movingComponentKey, frameComponentKey, a unit axis direction, and angular limits, but no project-owned pivot point/anchor that turns that direction into a unique rotation line. Two compliant Physical-World adapters can therefore consume the same canonical recipe and rotate the moving component around different lines while still honoring every currently documented field. Before articulated hinge/tilt realization becomes authoritative, serialize a project-owned pivot/anchor representation (or explicitly version an equivalent deterministic derivation rule) through an ObjectGenome schema/version decision, then add fixtures/tests that prove identical decoded geometry across adapters. Do not patch retained PR #395 in parallel solely for this mining finding.
evidence: Retained ObjectGenome PR #395 exact head ebfd17e7a2d5cf2083b90e0122b70bc5c39d0962 declares HingeMechanism/TiltMechanism with movingComponentKey, frameComponentKey, axis, minDegrees, and maxDegrees only; there is no pivot/anchor point or pivot-line field in either record shape.

Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md says mechanism axes are canonical unit direction vectors in the object-local basis and that mechanisms reference component keys plus plain axes/limits, while a later Roblox realization adapter may choose engine constraints. A direction vector alone does not identify where the rotation line passes through the authored object geometry.

The authored component transform is documented as the zero/reference pose, but neither the moving-component origin nor the frame-component origin is declared to be the hinge line. Inferring either location would therefore add adapter-defined physical meaning outside the canonical recipe.

Current tests exercise mechanism kinds, unit axes, limits, zero/reference decoding, exact shapes, and fixture fingerprints, but the v1 schema has no field on which a cross-adapter pivot-location invariant could be asserted.

This is distinct from the already-recorded caster swivel/roll axis relation finding, center-of-mass coherence, collection/state bounds, string budgets, and affordance-radius findings. No Roblox Studio, viewport, contact, performance-device, or two-client evidence is claimed.
